# uptimekuma_notification_wecom (Resource)

WeCom notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_wecom" "example" {
  name       = "WeCom Notifications"
  bot_key    = "your-bot-key"
  is_active  = true
  is_default = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_wecom" "alerts" {
  name       = "WeCom Alerts"
  bot_key    = "your-bot-key-for-alerts"
  is_active  = true
  is_default = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: bot_key_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change bot_key_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_wecom" "write_only" {
  name = "WeCom with a write-only secret"

  bot_key_wo         = "your-bot-key"
  bot_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `bot_key` (String, Sensitive) WeCom bot key. Stored in state; use `bot_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `bot_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) WeCom bot key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `bot_key`; requires `bot_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `bot_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `bot_key` until the next apply with `bot_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `bot_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `bot_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `bot_key_wo`.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
